configured.video_source: On-demand rendering uses saved actual trajectory/model/result only. No automatic full-episode rendering and no new physics for videos.
configured.manifest: Compact Git records and local source locations in the ordinary job/index, plus a small requested-diagnostic asset index with source/coverage, actual status, Release names/sizes/URLs and package-part mapping. This is not a mandatory inventory or upload of all unrequested bulk.
configured.git_scope: This job compact results, required2Hz/value/PANN/event exports, requested-diagnostic asset index/status, ordinary index and handoff; source/config before launch. Explicit W38 saved-data backfill is authorized. No blanket staging, unrelated changes or force push.
configured.status: Keep training target attainment, final evaluation, compact Git, explicitly requested diagnostic Release delivery, retained-local originals/unrequested bulk and user backup/deletion separate. Requested evidence stays pending until uploaded and indexed, or is explicitly reported unavailable.

release_parts.scope: Enabled for explicitly requested diagnostic evidence under outputs.requested_diagnostic_evidence: each new finished attempt core raw traces/trajectory/prediction plus model/metadata/small material logs, and necessary dense physical/material arrays. No blanket checkpoint/full-video upload. Reuse actual published destinations; uploader records its chosen tags/parts.

configured.evaluation_assets: Every evaluation result/config and numeric event summary goes to compact Git first. Release evidence includes original feedback/planner/reference, trajectory and all prediction files, matching model/metadata/small material logs, and complete high-rate physical/material arrays with Git asset links. Include both saved W38 E30s. Do not truncate/downsample arrays; full videos/weights remain unrequested unless separately selected.
